No. FIRMS recorded no thermal detections within ASSET-F07 (the rural property) between 2026-09-26 and 2026-10-26. The count of detections intersecting the asset boundary was zero. All four sensors (VIIRS S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21, and MODIS) covered every day of the period, so the result is not a coverage gap.

This does not prove that no fire occurred. Small, short-lived, cool, or cloud-obscured fires can go undetected. The result also says nothing about burned area, the cause of any change on the property, or anything outside this period.

The data are near-real-time FIRMS detections (375 m for VIIRS, 1 km for MODIS), evaluated as of 2026-11-12.
